decision_reason: Six exact MSigDB 2026.1 Hallmark sets frozen with msigdbr 26.1.1; all pass HGNC-symbol coverage. Outcome-blinded singscore scores validate for 401 samples; 150 verified paired changes link to composition. No outcome fields, mapping failures or score QC failures. Expression values and all 23,890 genes retained unchanged. Technical QC only; residual modelling, exploratory scoring and ssGSEA remain deferred.
